# `oaap assets`

the tenant's own asset universe: what apps name of themselves, in the tenant's twin (RFC-0088).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap assets {show,collect,on,off} [tenant]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `tenant` | 'on'/'off': the tenant |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | yes |
| `collect` | yes |
| `on` | yes |
| `off` | yes |
